'''Exploration''' is the process of discovering, surveying, mapping, and investigating star systems and astronomical bodies throughout the galaxy in ''[[Elite Dangerous]]''.

Commanders can use shipboard scanners to discover previously unknown systems and bodies, collect valuable cartographic data, locate planetary features, identify biological and geological signals, and investigate unusual phenomena. Exploration can range from surveying systems near inhabited space to long-range expeditions thousands of light-years beyond the Bubble.

Core exploration tools include the [[Discovery Scanner]], [[Full Spectrum System Scanner|Full Spectrum System Scanner (FSS)]], and [[Detailed Surface Scanner|Detailed Surface Scanner (DSS)]]. Surface exploration may also involve [[Exobiology]], [[Surface Recon Vehicles|surface vehicles]], and specialized exploration equipment.
